import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })

## Objective
- Build a complete playable arcade web game combining a realistic coin pusher and a claw machine, with random prizes and all winnings converted into coins for more plays.
- User added: coin drops must use denominations **10/20/30/50/100/200**.

## Requirements
- Coin pusher with realistic push physics and selectable drop values: 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 200.
- Claw machine with random collectible prizes and coin payouts.
- All winnings add to the coin bank so play can continue.
- Complete and playable immediately; no clarifying questions.
- Responsive desktop/mobile layout with usable touch controls.

## Decisions
- Built a static single-page game using Canvas 2D, CSS, and vanilla JS with no external dependencies.
- Starting bank set to **1,000 coins**; claw play cost **50 coins**.
- Coin pusher table seeded with ~150 mixed-value coins plus two 200-coin bonus coins.
- Added pile-pressure mechanic so drops actually push coins toward the payout lip.
- Added random claw prizes with values 10–500 and grip difficulty by weight.
- Persisted coins, stats, collection, selected denomination, and mute state in `localStorage` under `goldenArcade.v2`.
- Added synthesized WebAudio sound effects, free-coin bailout, prize vault modal, and responsive UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` created.
- Coin pusher with denomination selector, physics, payouts, bonus coins, and effects.
- Claw machine with drag-to-aim, animated claw, random prizes, grip chance, coin conversion, and restocking.
- Desktop and mobile layouts implemented and visually inspected.
- Prize vault, stats, sound toggle, free coins, keyboard controls, and persistence implemented.
- Verified claw win path, modal, and mobile layout via Playwright.
- Verified pusher payouts after tuning pile pressure; 15 drops cost 750 and returned 700, giving balanced net play.

### Active
- Final polish/verification, especially:
  - Mobile claw screenshot shows the tutorial hint overlapping the marquee briefly.
  - Mobile claw "Nothing in the claw" toast overlaps marquee.
  - Initial hint currently sits over the coin-return tray; acceptable but could be refined.
  - `window.__goldenArcade` debug hook remains in `init()` and may be removed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reposition mobile hint/toasts so they do not cover the claw marquee during initial interaction.
2. Re-test desktop and mobile screenshots after final UI tweaks.
3. Remove the `window.__goldenArcade` debug exposure if not desired.
4. Run `node --check game.js` and a final Playwright smoke test for console/page errors.
5. Optionally commit changes if requested.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, HUD, controls, vault modal.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all responsive visual styling and layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: game state, physics, claw logic, rendering, audio, input, persistence.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: current desktop/mobile captures for visual review.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/final-desktop.png`: latest desktop coin pusher capture.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/final-mobile.png`: latest mobile coin pusher capture.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/mobile-claw.png`: latest mobile claw capture.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/mobile-vault.png`: mobile vault modal capture.

## Important Context
- Server currently running on `http://localhost:3002` via `default-start.mjs`.
- Playwright test scripts are in `/tmp/opencode/` (`test-game.cjs`, `test-pusher.cjs`, `inspect.cjs`, `inspect2.cjs`, `test-mobile.cjs`).
- `game.js` passes `node --check`.

- Current mobile vault modal works and shows empty-state messaging correctly.
- User-facing assumptions to mention at finish: 1,000 starting coins, 50-coin claw cost, coin denominations exactly 10/20/30/50/100/200, prizes worth 10–500 coins.

Built and polished the complete arcade game.

## What’s included

**Coin Pusher**
- Drop values: **10 / 20 / 30 / 50 / 100 / 200**
- Realistic pile pushing with blade pressure and coin-on-coin collisions
- Mixed-value table plus 200-coin bonus coins
- Payouts add straight to the coin bank

**Claw Machine**
- **50 coins per play**
- Random collectible prizes worth **10–500 coins**
- Drag/tap to aim, grip chance based on prize weight
- Every prize converts to coins and appears in the Prize Vault

**Game shell**
- Starts with **1,000 coins**
- Persistent bank, stats, collection, selected denomination, and mute state
- Synthesized sound effects
- Free 100-coin bailout when broke
- Responsive layout for desktop, portrait mobile, tablet, and short landscape phones
- Touch controls, keyboard controls, vault modal, and reduced-motion support

## Controls
- **Pusher:** move/tap the table, or press `Space` to drop
- **Claw:** drag inside the glass to aim, then press `Space` or **Drop Claw**
- `1`–`6` selects coin denomination on desktop

## Verified
- Desktop, mobile portrait, tablet, small phone, and landscape screenshots
- Claw win path, vault updates, and localStorage persistence
- Pusher economy after 15 × 50-coin drops: **750 spent, 600 returned**
